description:
Found by the GC session in review of fz-9x7.21 (#693, merged as 6c26088c2); its fix was in an amend that arrived after the merge.

Since fz-9x7.21 a recycled heap block is not zeroed, so alloc_inline_bitstring (runtime/src/heap/imp.rs:938, `fill(from_raw_parts_mut(p.add(8), byte_len))`) hands fill callbacks a `&mut [u8]` over bytes nothing has written. from_raw_parts_mut requires initialized values: undefined behaviour in Rust's terms, even though every caller only writes.

Fix (written and gated by GC: 6934 passed, clippy, doc, 0xA5 poison fill): fill callbacks take `&mut [MaybeUninit<u8>]` and write with write_copy_of_slice, across alloc_bitstring_with, alloc_inline_bitstring, SharedBinHandle::from_filled, shared_bin_alloc_with and fz_binary_copy; two tests adjusted.

Blocks fz-9x7.25, whose SharedBin bytes become unwritten too.
title: A heap fill callback is handed unwritten bytes as MaybeUninit
